text.en: Reviewers speak warmly of the nursing and veterinary staff at Lissenhall, praising their reassurance and supportive guidance during emotional appointments. Longtime clients appreciate that clinicians take ample time to listen, explain medical diagnoses clearly, and answer questions thoroughly.

Clients highlight the tender and respectful handling received by elderly dogs and companion animals facing terminal conditions. Multiple reviews mention sensitive end-of-life care and careful emergency management for critically sick pets, creating reassuring peace of mind for families.

title.en: Detailed clinical advice alongside occasional friction

text.en: Many reviewers commend vets for providing thorough, patient explanations of complex treatments and emergency hospital procedures. In contrast, one dissatisfied client reported encountering a dismissive and abrupt consultation style when visiting with a different vet on duty.

q.en: Does Lissenhall Veterinary Hospital handle out-of-hours emergencies?

a.en: Yes, clients report bringing critically ill dogs to the emergency clinic at night and receiving prompt, attentive medical treatment.

q.en: Does the hospital provide compassionate pet end-of-life services?

a.en: Yes, reviewers express deep appreciation for the gentle, sensitive care and emotional support offered when putting elderly pets to rest.

q.en: Is a monthly pet health plan available at Lissenhall?

a.en: Clients mention using the clinic's monthly healthcare subscription, describing it as a convenient way to budget for routine visits.
